title: CS Enterprise Ask Stacking and Sprintable MVP Kit
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: We currently receive a high volume of distinct enterprise asks from Sales/CS that are small individually but together represent a large coordinator burden and potential product ROI. This initiative defines a lightweight 'stacking' process to aggregate related asks per account or use-case, produce a sprintable MVP ticket (+ acceptance criteria), and surface a standardized estimate and trade-offs for Product/Engineering review. Goal is to reduce churn in scoping, speed up delivery, and increase throughput of high-value enterprise features.
goal: Create a repeatable intake artifact (MVP kit) and scoring rubric so Sales/CS can turn multiple ask threads into a single prioritized, engineering-appetitive ticket within 48 hours of submission.
success_metrics: % of enterprise asks converted to sprint tickets within 48h >= 60%
Average scoping time (sales->PM handoff) down by 40%
Percent of bundled asks that ship as part of next 2 releases >= 30%
CS/Sales satisfaction score for intake process >= 8/10
proposed_solution: 1) Introduce a 'Stack' template used by AMs/CS: fields include customer pain, usage frequency, business outcome, security/regulatory constraints, suggested acceptance criteria, rough implementation appetite (S/M/L) and 'carrier' features. 2) Automate a priority score using rubric (value, coverage, complexity, compliance). 3) PM reviews stacks weekly and converts top items into a Sprintable MVP ticket with engineering estimate and rollout notes.
prioritization_rubric: Customer coverage (number of customers/accounts affected) — weight 25%
Risk & compliance (regulatory or security blockers) — weight 10%
Strategic alignment (OKR fit / platform enablement) — weight 10%
example_bundle: Account: NimbusHealth — three asks: streaming audit logs to SIEM, private model deployment template, faster embeddings for search
Stacked summary: 'Enterprise logging + private deployment' — suggested MVP: Private deployment packaging with audit-log toggle (M)
Estimated effort: 5 pts; business impact: high (regulated healthcare customer); dependencies: KMS integration, logging pipeline
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Pilot with 3 high-touch CS reps, validate template and rubric
Phase 2 (4 weeks): Build intake form in CS tooling (Helpdesk/Drive) and run weekly stack reviews with PMs
Phase 3 (8 weeks): Integrate scoring into console intake dashboard and auto-suggest existing roadmap items
Phase 4: Launch org-wide playbook and training for sales/CS
